observation: Frozen ZN-E010 (98,113 params) runs on NUCLEO-H7S3L8 only from the XSPI2 external flash: weights 350 KB (E fp32 288 KB; INT8 E fails Δ <= 0.001), latency 52.5 ms per new cycle with weights copied to SRAM (1.38 s when read from XSPI2). Application code + ST runtime ≈ 33 KB, so a model fully inside the 64 KB internal flash needs <= ~28 KB of weights.
primary_hypothesis: A structurally narrowed AnchoredFade-ResConv-GELU (stem 16/32 channels, d_model 32, 1 residual block, fade_hidden 32; 18,657 params ≈ 18 KB INT8) trained with the unchanged Phase-1 objective keeps most of ZN-E010's accuracy: split-2021 MAPE <= 0.3525 (ZN-E010 + 0.02) and Acc@15 >= 0.3365, making an internal-flash deployment possible.
question_inherited: How much accuracy does the Zn-ion model lose when shrunk to fit the 64 KB internal flash?
unresolved_from_reference: The accuracy-size trade-off of the frozen architecture family below 30 K parameters.
why_this_experiment: Phase 3 compression (phase3_targets.md M1 structured narrowing; user go 2026-11-17). Same architecture family and objective as the frozen model, so the only change is width/depth.
modification: Model width/depth only: cycle_stem 32/64 -> 16/32 channels, d_model 64 -> 32, residual blocks 2 -> 1, fade_hidden 64 -> 32 (T009 stem_widths). Training identical to ZN-E010 (Relative Huber 0.15, Adam 5e-4, batch 128, seed 2021, A2-ZN epochs).
changed_components: Encoder/fade/head widths and residual depth (structured compression).
held_constant_components: Architecture family (ResConv curve encoder + anchored fade encoder + masked summary + linear GELU head), GELU, objective, optimizer, data, split, seed, epoch rule.
controlled_variables: Training seed 2021, split 2021, minimum 5 / maximum 100 epochs, patience 5 after epoch 5, diagnostics every 50 steps.
expected_evidence: MAPE/Acc@15/RMSE vs ZN-E010; params; INT8/fp32 sizes; gradient gate; then 3-split confirmation and board check if kept.
rejection_condition: Phase-3 compression rule: KEEP (deployable compressed candidate) iff split-2021 MAPE <= 0.3525 AND Acc@15 >= 0.3365 AND gradient gate PASS AND prediction SD >= 10% of target SD; then confirm on splits 42/2024 (3-split mean MAPE <= 0.352). Otherwise DISCARD and report as a size-accuracy trade-off point.
minimum_evidence_requirements: At least five complete epochs; finite MAPE, Acc@15, MAE, and RMSE from one checkpoint; sample and unique-cell counts for every domain; gradient, update, activation, prediction, mask, and compute diagnostics.
required_diagnostics: Epoch learning curve; selected and minimum-MAPE epochs; cycle_stem, residual_blocks, fade_encoder, inter_summary and head gradients and updates; activation health; prediction spread and bias; prefix, domain and EOL errors; padding sensitivity; parameters, memory, time, throughput.

architecture_addendum.evidence: 64 KB internal-flash budget; INT8 of the full E fails accuracy
architecture_addendum.shapes: [B,100,3,300] -> ResConv [B,100,64] (h_t) -> u_t=[h_t, h_t-h_1] [B,100,128] -> Linear 128->64, GELU, Linear 64->64, +h_t -> g_t [B,100,64] * mask -> masked summary [B,192] -> Linear [B,64] -> GELU -> Linear [B,1]
architecture_addendum.mask_path: h_1 = cycle index 0 (always observed); g_t multiplied by mask; mean over mask==1, last at mask.sum()-1, delta last - first. tests/test_anchored_fade.py: padding invariance and cycle-1 dependence.
architecture_addendum.expected_evidence: MAPE, RMSE, Acc@15, DB-MAPE (= MAPE) vs ZN-E005; EOL bands; gradient gate incl. fade_encoder

smoke_evidence: CUDA smoke ZN-E022S on Kaggle Tesla T4: identical config, 92 optimizer steps, worker preflight passed (phase3_tinyml), finite (val MAPE 0.4091 -> 0.4110), gradient HEALTHY in every block, executed train.py md5 = reviewed. Artifacts: diagnostics/ZN-E022S_cuda_smoke/.
